insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Varus is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Varus in 32/62 games (52%): 7 picks (3-4) and 25 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Gwen? They go Ambessa
insights.text: Gwen is a G1 favorite (7/26 G1s, played by Wizer). In the 22 later games where it was burned or banned, Wizer went to Ambessa (5/22) and Jax (5/22).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 18 G3+ games, 24/90 picks (27%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 53 champs in G1s, 56 in G3+.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: They get stronger as the series goes deep
